narr: A cold front generated thunderstorms as it moved through South Central Texas. One of these storms produced heavy rain that led to flash flooding.
ev: Thunderstorms produced heavy rain that led to flash flooding. Water completely covered El Indio Hwy in Eagle Pass. Several vehicles were stranded with water up to their bumpers.
lsr: PHOTO ON SOCIAL MEDIA SHOWS WATER COMPLETELY OVER EL INDIO HIGHWAY WITH WATER OVER THE BUMPER OF SEVERAL VEHICLES.
